name: Items 1: every played jewel perk at five times its built size (the always-on upper bound of sizing a perk by its case)
why: 54-review-items call 2 and 47 C8. A perk measured about 1% of XP at its built size. Sized for its case it is meant to be 5 to 8% there. The matrix cannot tell a case from an ordinary hunt, so this patch makes every played perk five times as large everywhere: it is what a hero whose every perk matched the ground would gain, and what an always-on perk (Keen, Follow-through, Surge) would do if it were sized like a narrow one. It targets the gear bands. Any pace, survival or gold band it moves is the trace.
